saw_lines: Dog owners don’t try a new chew on a whim. They switch when something stops working and a friend swears by the fix.
So the ad has to open on the problem and close with the deal, every time.
17 of your 43 live ads share one opening line and 0 mention your 25% bundle offer. New hooks, offer in every ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active US ads, 9 Oct 2026
points: The offer never reaches the ads
The site leads with up to 25% off bundles and 20% Subscribe & Save. 0 of 43 ads mention a discount, bundle, subscription or the money back guarantee.
17 of 43 ads open with the same “70% of a dog’s immune system” line, so they bid against each other for the same people.
21 ads started on 28 Sep. Launched as one batch, the budget can’t pick winners. Stagger launches and cut losers early.
Products are rated 4.3 to 4.9 on the site. 0 ads use a review, a rating or a customer quote.
